caption: Atal Pension Yojana pays a guaranteed pension from age 60: Rs 42 a month at 18 buys a Rs 1,000 pension. Start at 40 and the same pension costs Rs 291 a month. Save this for later, and follow Rupee Sense for the next money basic.

items: Join by age 40. After that, no entry.
